title: Intern / Project Manager / Developer / Business Analyst
description: Led the design and proof of a clinical-study migration process spanning project management, business analysis, and Perl development. Migrated several thousand records between Electronic Data Capture systems, established a production-ready approach, and supported a recommendation estimated to save tens of millions of dollars.
highlights: Developed Perl tooling and migrated several thousand clinical-study records to prove the approach.
Created work instructions and design documentation so the team could operate the migration process after the internship.
Reviewed vendor solutions and built a cost-savings analysis estimating benefits in the tens of millions of dollars.
Presented the recommended approach to the CIO and saw it adopted for production use.
Continued providing technical guidance to the team after the internship as they operated the solution.
